### Phase 14: intra-group cover region parallelism

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase14-region-cover-parallel/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Close the four-thread utilization gap on frames with fewer LF groups than workers. Prefill each underfilled group's complete square-transform candidate cache once, then score its independent aligned 32x32 cover regions through immutable cache reads on the existing request executor and reduce in raster order. Preserve the current lazy group path when LF groups already saturate workers and retain only if output is byte-identical and mid-size speed materially improves without a large-image regression.
